_comment: Week 3 Phase 3B classical-arm configurations. GENERATED by phase3b/scripts/make_methods.py from configs/phase3a_methods.json -- do not hand-edit. The `shared` and `flatport_params` blocks are carried across verbatim so that a Phase 3B run differs from its Phase 3A counterpart in exactly the one field the hypothesis varies. Phase 3A's config file is never modified and Phase 3A's outputs are never mutated.

_reused_from_phase3a.note: F1 and F4 are NOT re-run. Reusing them is what keeps the 2x2 factorial cheap, and it is legitimate because the shared settings block below is byte-identical to the one those runs used.

flatport_params.int_normal_note: A GoPro's lens cover is parallel to the sensor by construction, so the interface normal is the optical axis. Assumed exactly, not measured; a real tilt of a degree or two is possible.
flatport_params.int_dist_note: Projection-centre-to-inner-glass distance. The Refractive COLMAP authors describe their GoPro flat-port stand-off as under 2 mm; this is the top of that range so the refractive model is not handicapped by an under-estimate.
flatport_params.int_thick_note: Lens-cover thickness. GoPro covers are approximately 1 mm.
flatport_params.n_glass_note: Matches the fork's own example value; GoPro covers are alkali-aluminosilicate glass, n approximately 1.51.
flatport_params.n_water_note: Seawater at typical dive salinity/temperature is 1.339-1.342; fresh water (the cenote clip) is 1.333. One value is used for every clip because the difference is far below the parameter uncertainty above.

shared.matcher_note: 48 frames is 1128 pairs -- cheap enough to match exhaustively, which avoids choosing a sequential-overlap parameter and lets the out-and-back revisits in wreck_05/wreck_07 close naturally.
shared.multiple_models_note: COLMAP's default. An earlier version of this experiment set it to false to force one model per run; reading src/colmap/controllers/incremental_mapper.cc showed that `!multiple_models` BREAKS OUT OF THE INITIALISATION LOOP after the first trial, so the whole reconstruction became a single lottery draw on the initial image pair -- several clips 'failed' at 2/48 registered purely because of that, and one configuration reconstructed 48/48 on one run and 3/48 on an identical rerun. Restored to true, which lets the mapper retry initial pairs (init_num_trials=200). The original worry -- a run looking successful while actually producing several mutually inconsistent fragments -- is handled by REPORTING every sub-model's size and evaluating only the largest, rather than by crippling the mapper.
shared.use_gpu_note: CPU everywhere. There is no CUDA on this machine, COLMAP's GPU SIFT path on macOS needs an OpenGL context, and the CPU path is the more reproducible instrument.
shared.mapper_num_threads_note: Single-threaded MAPPING. COLMAP's seed does not make multithreaded incremental mapping reproducible, and configuration C's entire claim is a difference between two runs, so the one stage whose nondeterminism changes the reconstruction's structure is pinned. Feature extraction and matching stay multithreaded; the residual spread from those is MEASURED by the repeat runs rather than assumed away.
shared.model_selection: largest sub-model by registered images; all sub-model sizes recorded

F2.role: 3B-1 matcher axis with SIFT features FIXED. Identical to Phase 3A configuration A in every respect except the matcher type. F1->F2 is therefore the matcher effect at constant feature representation.
F2.attribution_note: SIFT_LIGHTGLUE and ALIKED_LIGHTGLUE are DIFFERENT LightGlue ONNX weights, and SIFT_BRUTEFORCE and ALIKED_BRUTEFORCE compare different descriptors. The matcher axis this factorial measures is 'nearest-neighbour matching vs the learned LightGlue matcher trained for that descriptor', not one matcher applied to two descriptors. That is the strongest factorial the installed binary permits and every claim is scoped to it.

F3.role: 3B-1 matcher axis with ALIKED_N32 features FIXED. Identical to Phase 3A configuration B in every respect except the matcher type. F3->F4 is therefore the matcher effect at constant learned feature representation.
F3.extractor_note: ALIKED_N32, the same variant Phase 3A configuration B used, so F3 -> F4 varies the matcher alone.
